definition.simple: A short written set of rules for how you trade: what, when, how you enter and exit, and how much you risk. You write it before you trade, while you are calm.
definition.balanced: It covers instruments, sessions, timeframe, entry, exit, [[stop-loss]] and [[take-profit]] rules, risk per trade, a daily loss limit, a maximum number of trades, and when to stop. Change it between sessions, not during a trade, and keep each version so you can compare them.

example: A plan might say: "EUR/USD only, London session, 1-hour chart, stop on every trade, example risk 1% per trade, stop for the day after 2 losses."
